defect.cause: loadProgress performed UpdateAsync claim after yielding GetAsync even when PlayerRemoving had cleared the pending session.
defect.reproduction: Canonical whole-server tests/auto/progression_rejoin_spec.lua: disconnect while read yields frees slot without a ghost plot failed (expected 0 writes, got 1) in exact-head offline CI #40596714434.

fix: Pass pending join state to loadProgress; after GetAsync and schema validation, verify the player is still parented and the same pending state owns the slot before attempting any UpdateAsync claim.
character_impact: No character stats, prices, or combat changes; avoids stale DataStore ownership claim on disconnect.

tests.reproduction_case: disconnect while read yields frees slot without a ghost plot

limitations: Canonical offline mock only; live Roblox DataStore/engine not run.
Session owner supersession does not transfer unsaved progress.
next_action: Require both exact-head CI jobs success, independent reviewer only for main integration.
